tool_args.rationale: The added open-branch observation increases coverage at a low gradient, and all six paid rows remain subcritical. Fit the cited saturating base response with sink-gradient modulation and a square-root local contribution; parameters are estimated numerically from train_rows. The prior execution error was a variable-scope issue, avoided by storing fitted parameters in module state.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed gradients are at most 2.2, below the cited trigger near 2.36; testing the supercritical avalanche branch is not justified for this evidence.
The six observations support fitting the smooth subcritical response; additional trajectory measurements are unnecessary before model confirmation.
A substrate-only Haldane curve cannot explain the systematic response variation with s_grad.
It lacks the saturating base-field and sink-gradient suppression indicated by the pilot signatures.
